restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 62 and 1024t + 64 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length. The two blocks share every word except w4 and w5 (w4' = w4 + 2, w5' = w5 - 2, Lemma L62 of proof.md Section 8); bytes 62 and 63 are zero in both (w15 < 2^16), w13 = b2077fc6 and w14 is free. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 9 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7 (Lemma L62, Fact P62 on the pin W4 = a40d3321, X3 = 435d473f, X7 = 9895859e, X11 = 9003b0e0, X15 = a7590cb9, W13 = b2077fc6, Lemma H62, Theorem C62). The first value e of E3 ranges over the class of eta = 85492711 (2^20 values), E1.c1 over the cube of beta = f5519714 (2^16 values), and t is solved per trial; trials with t = 0 are skipped. Only the two outcome rows tau = aaaf751e and aaaf771e (eps = 2559f8e8) are searched; their exact local counts give the model mass mu = 36583/2^121 per raw proposal (Section 10). Heuristic part: B = 2^105.318 raw proposals succeed with probability at least 0.39 under H1-AY and H4-AY. The pin, eta, beta, eps and the two rows are fixed nonuniform advice (76 bytes, proof.md 12.1); the success analysis uses only properties of them verified exactly in the proof (Lemma ADV).

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units per target compression, at most 16 live registers. Charged (proof.md Sections 11 to 13, GPT Sol answer AY 18): 29,120 per batch of seven scalar raw proposals with their E lookups, 80 per E-positive proposal, 4,128 + 44,543,808 per solver entry (the solver cap at every entry), tables 2^29, 16 boundary units, the computation that found the advice at 2^70 word operations (proof.md 12.2, premise HPRE-discovery-bound) and 2^38 compressions to write and verify the messages. The budgets (J batches, LE E-positive proposals, L2 solver entries) are halts charged at bound plus one; no mean of a work count is used. These are proved upper allowances of a specified layout; nothing is implemented or measured.

A distinct path filed at its own price. time_log2 109.2779 is the bound (O_f + 2^70)/430 + 2^38 rounded up at the fourth decimal and checked by integer 10,000th powers on both sides (proof.md 13.3). The term 2^70, the discovery computation of the advice (HPRE-discovery-bound), adds 5e-15 bit; with 2^72, or any bound up to 2^103, the claim is the same. Success 0.39 holds only under H1-AY (rate factor 51 per 2^128 and weak dependence) and H4-AY (budgets); no premise about a selection procedure is used (proof.md Lemma ADV). No full 2-round collision is exhibited. A no-filter variant without H4-AY is priced at 121.98 and is not claimed.

The submitted program and the two experiments are those of entry 26ebba63, unchanged: they run the 55/63 root instance (single chunks of 55 and 63 bytes, counter 0, flags 11; proof.md Sections 3 to 6). The program does not run this path: nothing of the 62/64 construction, the pin, the class, the cube, the filters or the solver is in it, and no implementation of any part of this path has been run. The local exact counts of proof.md Section 10 were made by participant programs outside the package.

memory_log2_bytes 44 covers the two messages (each below 2^42 bytes), the lookup tables (983,040 bytes), the solver and the 76-byte advice record, all held at once; the memory of the discovery computation is not part of the run and is not covered. preprocessing_log2 62 bounds the tables and the discovery computation, (2^70 + 2^29)/430 < 2^61.2519 target compressions, and is included in time_log2. The search reads 76 bytes of fixed nonuniform advice (the 24-byte pin, eta, beta, eps and the two rows with their class, cube and solver words; proof.md 12.1), declared as nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes 6.248 (76 < 2^6.248); the computation that found them is charged as preprocessing (HPRE-discovery-bound). No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. For the actual sampler of proof.md 11.1 (the pin of 8.2; the seven outer words, r = w14 uniform on all words, z = w15 uniform on 0..65535 and a member e of the class of eta = 85492711 drawn with fresh coins per raw proposal; E1.c1 over the cube of beta = f5519714; the two outcome rows aaaf751e and aaaf771e), (i) the expected number of valid listed roots of one raw proposal is at least (N_c - 1) * f / 2^128 with N_c = 2^16 and f = floor(5 * 36583 / 3584) = 51, five sevenths of the model rate per trial (36583 / 2^137 = 71.45 * 2^-128) rounded down; and (ii) the probability that the unhalted run of B = 50,575,779,322,124,053,188,182,925,749,242 raw proposals has no listed root is at most exp(-0.49676) + 0.001. This is GPT Sol's hypothesis H1-AY (answer AY 18.6), declared here; the 55/63 premise of the participant's earlier entries is not transferred.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 9 to 11: lengths 1024t + 62 and 1024t + 64 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the pin of Section 8, e in the class of eta (2^20 values), c1 in the cube of beta (2^16 values), t solved per trial and t = 0 skipped, and only the two rows of Section 10.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the exact local counts of proof.md 10.2 under GPT Sol's counting model: L = 2^27 and N3Sigma = 47 * 2^57 for tau = aaaf771e, L = 2^28 and N3Sigma = 12519 * 2^47 for tau = aaaf751e, pair mass mu = 36583 / 2^121 = 2^-105.8411 per raw proposal, taken at five sevenths and rounded down. Participant evidence (Section 10.3, untrusted by the harness): an exhaustive local screen of the 15,180-pair grid found exactly these two positive rows, and an independent recount, brute-force-checked at widths 6 to 8, agrees exactly on L and N3Sigma of both rows and fixed the normalization of mu by one bit. The local mass of E1 and E3 and the parameter count of the chart do not prove the physical first moment or the dependence clause.
heuristics.limitations: Declared, not proved and not measured. No rate of this path has been measured at any width: no implementation of the path exists, and the organizer-run experiments run the 55/63 root instance of entry 26ebba63's program, which contains nothing of this path. The factor 51 and the dependence clause are assumed. The definitions of L and N3Sigma, the filters' necessity and the solver's losslessness are GPT Sol's (answer AY sections 1 to 3, 10 and 14 to 18) and are summarized, not reproduced, in proof.md.

heuristics.statement: Supporting, filtered path only. The probability that the count of E-positive raw proposals exceeds LE = 219,723,112,305,481,250,688,653,171,096 or the count of solver entries exceeds L2 = 2,871,968,522,982,158,364,169,218,308 is at most 0.0005. A sufficient form: the raw proposals are independent and P(E-positive) <= 1.06 pE, P(both masks meet) <= 1.06 p2, with pE = 8575 / 2^21 and p2 = 7345443 / 2^37; Chernoff then gives the budgets, each ceil(17/16 * B * share). GPT Sol's hypothesis H4-AY (answer AY 18.6), declared here.
heuristics.scope: The two counts of proof.md 11.1 over the B raw proposals of the run; the indicators of one proposal may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The shares are exact for uniform independent input words: GPT Sol's exact input-word histograms of the two existence automata (proof.md 11.2), whose sums, pE and p2 the participant recomputed in exact arithmetic. The budgets LE and L2 were recomputed exactly from B and the shares.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved and not measured: the sampler's words Q = Y9 and E = e + w8 are not proved uniform, and nothing of this path has been run. The time bound does not depend on this premise, since every count halts at its budget. The no-filter variant of proof.md 13.4 (121.98, not claimed) needs no such premise.

heuristics.statement: Supporting. All discovery computation, that is all computation that found the fixed advice record of proof.md 12.1 (the six pin words, eta, beta, eps and the two rows with their class, cube and solver words: GPT Sol's answers AX 3.1 and AY and the participant's local screens and recounts of proof.md 10.3), is at most 2^70 charged 32-bit word operations, under the participant's attested device list and window of proof.md 12.2. It is charged as preprocessing, 2^70 machine units = 2^70/430 target compressions, inside time_log2 (proof.md 13.3).
heuristics.scope: The once-only computation that produced the 76-byte record of proof.md 12.1, on every machine used by any of the project's models over the 30-day window from 2026-10-05 (2,592,000 s); not the run, which is charged separately in full (proof.md 13.2).
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's cost-proof note PREPROC_BOUND.md, reproduced in proof.md 12.2: peak rates of 1 x RTX 3090 (44,083,200,000,000 operations per second), 4 x RTX 3070 (94,208,000,000,000), 24 local CPU cores (16,896,000,000,000), 64 server CPU cores (45,056,000,000,000) and at most 4 cloud and model sandboxes of 64 cores each (180,224,000,000,000), in all 380,467,200,000,000 = 2^48.4348 per second; over 2,592,000 s this is 986,170,982,400,000,000,000 = 2^69.7404 < 2^70, an exact integer product. Every rate takes the peak boost clock, every lane busy every cycle and a fused operation counted as two.
heuristics.limitations: The device list and the window are a participant attestation, not a measurement. The hardware-instruction to word-operation conversion is assumed one-to-one: each charged word operation is taken to need at least one hardware 32-bit lane-instruction. The procedure of GPT Sol's answer AX 3.1 that produced the pin is not recorded; it is covered only as computation on the listed machines, and model reasoning that produced formulas is not counted as search. Sensitivity: the term adds 5.0e-15 to log2 T. If the bound were 2^72, N = O_f + 2^72 + 430 * 2^38 = 338,353,089,784,848,942,078,372,161,451,965,248, log2(N/430) = 109.27782003..., and the claim would be exactly the same, 109.2779 (N^10000 < 2^1092779 * 430^10000 and N^10000 > 2^1092778 * 430^10000); it stays 109.2779 for any bound up to 2^103 and not at 2^104.
